investigation.method: Compared vitest log output between a slow run (08-13, tests-web job, run-tests step 374s, vitest Duration 364.19s: transform 134.78s / import 1931.94s / tests 863.40s) and a fast run (08-16, tests-web job, run-tests step 77s, vitest Duration 74.89s: transform 35.23s / import 292.76s / tests 282.62s). Same 238 test files, ~4300-4400 tests both times. Reused unchanged from run 18/19 -- no new sampling performed this run.
investigation.finding: Entire suite scaled proportionally slower (~5x across transform/import/tests) on the slow run -- not a single regressed test. Worker-shard comparison (08-13 Duration 216.21s vs 08-16 97.09s) shows the same pattern (import 437s vs 145s). Consistent with CI-runner-level resource contention (Blacksmith self-hosted runners; BLACKSMITH_RUNNER_ACQUIRE_JOB_MS/BLACKSMITH_RUNNER_MESSAGE_WAIT_MS env vars present in job logs) rather than a code-level regression.
investigation.discardedHypothesis: The 'Failed to save: Unable to reserve cache with key Linux-turbo-tests-web-compile-...another job may be creating this cache' log line was checked and appears identically in both the fast and slow runs -- confirmed NOT a causal factor, not attributed in this report.
investigation.conclusion: Environment/runner-infra variability, outside repo's control this run; not fixable via a ci-perf/ PR or a pipeline.yml change. Not actionable per this workflow's own rules. Not re-investigated this run (no new information changes the conclusion).
